title: Sheinbaum Mocks Calderón: “It Would Be a Gem for Him to Talk About Democracy”
author: Anahí Del Ángel
content:
_This article by[Anahí Del Ángel](https://contralinea.com.mx/author/anahida/)
originally appeared in the [September 30, 2026 edition of Revista
Contralínea](https://contralinea.com.mx/interno/semana/sheinbaum-ironiza-
sobre-calderon-seria-una-joya-que-hablara-de-democracia/), Mexico's leading
independent investigative journalism outlet._

In response to the arrival in Mexico of former president **Felipe Calderón
Hinojosa** to take part in the **Foro América Libre** , President **Claudia
Sheinbaum Pardo** said ironically: **" if he talks about democracy […] it
would be a gem, the spurious Calderón talking about democracy,"** in allusion
to the electoral fraud of 2006.

The head of the federal Executive anticipated that the former president's
message would center on **democracy** , since the opposition has spoken out
repeatedly on the subject.

However, she added that Calderón could refer to the case of **Genaro García
Luna** , who was his **Secretary of Security** and is currently serving a
**38-year prison sentence** in the **United States** , after a court in that
country found him guilty of several crimes related to drug trafficking and of
having received millions in bribes from the **Sinaloa Cartel**.

She also mentioned that he could clarify "what he published, at the time,
about the former governor of Baja California **[Ernesto Ruffo Appel]** ," whom
he accused in 2017 of having ties to the **Arellano Félix brothers** , leaders
of the **Tijuana Cartel** , and with whom he later expressed solidarity when
the politician was arrested in investigations linking him to the crime of
**fiscal _huachicol_** (fuel smuggling disguised to evade taxes).

The president considered that the former PAN president could answer **" why
did the number of homicides double, or more than double, during his six-year
term?"**, one of the subjects he has avoided talking about since leaving
office.

Finally, in response to accusations of supposed authoritarianism from groups
opposed to the Fourth Transformation, she spoke out in favor of the freedoms
guaranteed in Mexico:

> He is welcome to keep talking, go ahead, **freedom of expression to the
> max**.
>
> President Claudia Sheinbaum
